source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: أول مرة ركبت قطار، كنت متحمس كتير.
sentences.en: The first time I rode a train, I was very excited.
I got to the station early and sat waiting.

sentences.ar: لما إجا القطار، ركبت وقعدت جنب الشباك.
sentences.en: When the train came, I got on and sat by the window.
The train started moving and the scenery changed.

sentences.ar: شفت حقول وبيوت وجبال بتمر بسرعة.
sentences.en: I saw fields, houses, and mountains passing by quickly.

sentences.ar: جنبي قعد رجال كبير وحكالي عن سفراته.
sentences.en: Next to me sat an old man who told me about his travels.

sentences.ar: الوقت مر بسرعة ونحنا عم نحكي.
sentences.en: Time passed quickly while we were talking.
When I arrived, I said goodbye to the man and thanked him.

sentences.ar: رحلة القطار خلتني أحب السفر أكتر.
sentences.en: The train trip made me love traveling more.
